name: Is large-format tile a good idea for a walk-in shower floor?

mainEntity.name: Is large-format tile a good idea for a walk-in shower floor?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Large-format tile can reduce grout lines, but it does not eliminate the need for a properly prepared, sloped, and waterproofed shower assembly. Smaller or mosaic tile may fit slopes and curved details more easily, while larger tile can create a cleaner appearance but may require flatter surfaces and careful cuts.

Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate tile selections with the pan, niches, bench, drain, and existing bathroom style.

Key factors:
- Tile size versus floor slope
- Slip resistance and wet-area suitability
- Drain style and cut complexity
- Wall flatness and pattern alignment

Choose grout color, edge details, and maintenance expectations together with tile size. Ask where cuts and seams will fall before approving the layout.

A visually simple tile choice may still require more precise preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: It can work on suitable surfaces, but shower floors need accurate slope and a tile layout that manages drainage. Smaller mosaics often follow slopes more easily; large tile may create fewer grout lines but more complex cuts. Confirm the floor plan before ordering materials.
